# Sashiko AI Introducing Linux Performance Specialist Review Stage

> "Linux Performance Specialist Review Stage and Benchmarking: Add an optional performance specialist analysis stage to linux_patch_review (available in daemon and local sashiko review, including --stages performance and --cheap) with second-order side-effect tracing and anti-noise guardrails Add expect_clean neutral benchmark support, per-stage false-positive tracking, and the balanced 40-commit benchmark_performance.json suite (20 upstream regressions + 20 soak-verified clean commits)"

> Integrate an optional performance specialist stage into ANALYSIS_STAGES in linux_patch_review.rs for both local (sashiko review, including --stages performance and --cheap) and daemon review modes, backed by projects/linux/prompts/performance.md and aligned rules in false-positive-guide.md and severity.md. Because kernel performance regressions are usually unexpected side effects of ordinary bug fixes, cleanups, and struct layout changes: - Schedule performance on any non-trivial C, Rust, or struct/header change while skipping pure docs, comments, or ID tables. - Trace callers and outer embedding structs 1-2 hops outward using repository tools, forbidding self-dismissals based on short critical sections, cold teardown rationalizations, or treating a stated correctness mechanism as an accepted throughput/latency cliff. - Exclude speculative micro-optimizations, zero-delta guard(mutex) cleanups, and bounded one-shot control paths without fan-out. Controlled A/B benchmark on benchmark_performance.json (40 commits: 20 upstream regressions + 20 neutral expect_clean commits) using gemini-4-argon at high effort: - Positive detection: 3/20 (15.0%) baseline -> 14/20 (70.0%) (+55.0 pp, 9 of 11 net-new wins originated solely from performance). - Neutral clean rate: 11/20 (55.0%) baseline -> 12/20 (60.0%) (0 new false-positive neutral commits; 52 -> 51 total unmatched findings). - Resource overhead: +11.0% median input tokens (91.4% cached) and -3.1% median per-commit duration.
